answer: Give every agent a work permit, issued only by an established peer that stakes reputation on the newcomer. A permit is the jetty between a new identity and paid work: it lets one job dock, then expires at epoch end and cannot be sold or copied. The kernel of the design is scarcity by sponsorship — a sponsor can vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, so flooding the network with clones costs sponsors their standing. Trust climbs toward its zenith slowly, one vouched job at a time, and a fake fleet starves at the dock because no sponsor will burn reputation on a thousand strangers.
